title: Appearance Of The Staff
paragraphs: “Luna protected Keel-kun! Cute Keel-kun is the treasure of the world! I won’t let him get hurt!”
“Stop! Don’t cling to me! Whoa! I’m getting buried in feathers! Someone, help me!”
“Luna-chan, let go of Keel-kun. You like him when he’s free, don’t you?”
Father gently scolded Luna-chan, who was clinging to Keel.

“Those who possess both wisdom and strength must be magnanimous… They acknowledge others. Who would rejoice in clinging to outdated, bloodstained traditions and bringing about tragedy? While it is the duty of vassals to speak out when a king gives a wrong order, overthrowing the king just because he made an unfavorable choice is no different from having no loyalty to the nation.”
Yuki-chan still enjoys using complicated phrasing.
“Maybe so… The Three Heroes Church probably thinks they’re the ones truly running the country and disregard the royal family.”
“It’s a complicated issue.”
“Whether the king is right or the religion is… huh.”

“They refuse reconciliation, underestimate the waves that could destroy the world, ask the heroes to save the world, and plot world domination behind the scenes. I can’t think of them as a righteous organization.”
Everyone nodded at Itsuki’s words. Even the Queen had been trying to seek a path of reconciliation, after all. But in all the previous loops, the Three Heroes Church never once chose that path.
“Anyway, this is the decisive moment. Let’s take down the Three Heroes Church that’s infiltrated the castle!”
“Ohhh!”

Everyone except me let out a battle cry in response to Itsuki’s declaration. Such a dangerous situation… or is it? Honestly, I still think it would be quicker to just kill the pope and the others with a preemptive strike. But Father said that just cutting off the head isn’t enough, and I learned that the hard way in the previous loop. If we can ensure that no new head grows back by taking this approach, then it’s worth doing.
“Father.”
“What is it, Motoyasu-kun?”
“If we destroy the Three Heroes Church this time, will another head grow back?”
“A new head? Ah… I get what you’re saying. Well… it’s not impossible, but this time, we should be able to buy enough time before the next one appears.”

I see. So, in the end, enemies will always exist in some form. But if we can buy time until they show themselves and crush them before they grow too powerful, that’s enough. It’s a hassle, but I’ve learned something new. With that thought, we moved to the castle using the portal.
“So, you’ve finally arrived… You’re slower than I expected.”

However, the Three Heroes Church… including the pope, had already been defeated. From atop the castle gate that connected the castle town to the castle, Trash… with a staff in one hand, spoke to us. With a loud clank, the gate opened, and we were left speechless. The plaza was littered with the corpses of the Three Heroes Church followers, their weapons shattered, and the pope lay dead.
“W-What is this…?”
“They’ve already been dealt with. You don’t need to trouble yourselves any further,” Trash declared, descending from the gate and walking past Father.
“Hmph.”
Letting out such a sound, Trash briskly walked away toward the detention tower within the castle.

What happened here? Looking closely, fallen soldiers were scattered around the castle courtyard and other areas, while other soldiers were carrying them away. Soon after, the Queen arrived, crossing paths with Trash. I don’t think it’s my imagination that she seemed to be smiling.
“Heroes, thank you for arriving as planned. It seems fortune is on our side. All that remains is to capture the heretics causing chaos in the castle town.”
“Um… What happened?” Father cautiously asked the Queen.
The Queen looked toward the detention tower and answered.
“I only heard this from Trash, but…”

Apparently, some soldiers loyal to the Three Heroes Church had infiltrated the castle, and today was the day they planned to depose the Queen. The castle was fortified with trusted allies, but the Three Heroes Church, believing Trash would join their cause, stormed the detention tower. Up until now, the Hakuko siblings had been taking care of Trash. The younger sister had been keeping him company. Since meeting the Hakuko siblings, Trash, who had always spent his time staring blankly out the window, gradually began to show a gentler expression as he lived with them. That being said, Trash still rarely moved from the window. When the soldiers of the Three Heroes Church, thinking Trash would lead the charge against the Queen, approached him, they encountered the Hakuko siblings. Seeing them, they must have mistaken them for enemies and drew their weapons.
“Die, you devils who follow the devil of the shield!”
“What the hell are you doing?!”

Fohl fought back, but his level was low, and they were vastly outnumbered. Trash, utterly useless, stood there bewildered, unable to do anything but watch. It only lasted a minute or two. In that chaos, it was natural that the soldiers’ attention shifted to the weaker sister. A sword swung down, bypassing Fohl’s guard and aiming at the sister.
“Hahaha! Die, Hakuko!”
“Kyahhh!”
Seeing his sister scream, Trash snapped back to reality and sprang into action.
“St-Stopppppppppppppppppppppppppp!”
At that moment, perhaps Trash finally realized what he had been doing, what he needed to do, what he had been caught up in due to his personal feelings.

If I recall correctly, Trash and the Hakuko siblings are blood relatives, aren’t they? The precious remnant of his beloved sister was about to be killed right before his eyes. And yet, he could do nothing. The soldiers didn’t seem inclined to listen to his orders.

What was right? What was wrong? Even his desire to take revenge on Siltvelt, which had consumed him for so long, now seemed distant. While talking with the Hakuko siblings, Trash grasped the situation. Right now, he only wanted to protect the precious remnant of his beloved sister standing before him. Perhaps responding to that desire, a staff appeared before Trash.
“Oh! The Wise King of Wisdom!”

Witnessing such a miracle, the soldiers of the Three Heroes Church seemed to misunderstand something. They thought the Queen and Father were tormenting Trash by forcing him, against his will, to be cared for by the Hakuko. They believed that by barging in, they had created an opportunity for Trash to take the staff and join them. If that was the case, they figured they should leave the disposal of the Hakuko to Trash.
“Atla!”
Fohl stepped in front of his sister, standing protectively to shield her with his body.
“Now, Wise King of Wisdom! It is time to eliminate the Hakuko, the vile agents sent by the false queen and the imposter heroes!”

Trash gripped the staff floating before him, gave it a slight swing, and silently walked toward the Hakuko siblings. By the way, before this point, during occasional visits, the Queen had told him a little about the heroes. Only a little about their strengthening methods.
“Behold! This marks the birth of the new Melromarc!”

The soldier proclaimed triumphantly, while Trash gazed at the Hakuko siblings. In that moment, the Three Heroes Church believed that their greatest ally, the Wise King of Wisdom, would strike down the Queen and the Hakuko, bringing about the defeat of the false heroes. But in the next instant—
“Haah! Drypha Lightning Bolt X!”
Trash aimed the staff at the soldiers and unleashed magic.
“Gyaaaaaaaaaaaahhhh!”
The soldiers collapsed simultaneously, struck by the high-voltage lightning magic.
“W-Why… Wise King of Wisdom…”
“W-What is this…?”
Trash, with a grim expression, stepped over the fallen soldiers. Then, with a gentle smile, he extended his hand to the Hakuko siblings.
“Are you both unharmed?”
“Ah… yeah…”
“We’re fine.”

Hearing those words from the Hakuko siblings, Trash used magic to levitate the soldiers and threw them out of the room. The sound of clashing swords echoed from outside the tower… resounding throughout the castle.
“It seems things are getting noisy outside. Wait here. I’ll take care of it.”
“But that’s—”
Before Fohl could object, Trash turned and answered.
“Most likely… Mirellia… and the Spear Hero… would wish for this as well…”
At that moment, Trash seemed to have questioned the meaning of the staff appearing before him and realized what he needed to do.
